text.tspan: 1 | O-GlcNAc sites concentrate into regional clusters
Clustering survives removal of the strongest effects
A retains original CRTC3 vector tracks. Atlas: 824 regions on 477 region-bearing proteins; 4,196 of 12,491 validated sites retained. C: 95% matched-protein
bootstrap CIs; coral marks radius 10 (1,022 proteins at every radius). C and F are post hoc sensitivities. D compares distinct populations and null models. E
retains authored vectors; F uses all 1,057 proteins and 500 random-removal orders.
